---
title: "Sample_Correlations_AB"
author: "Andrew Becker"
output: html_document
date: "2025-11-30"
R_version: "4.4.2"
description: "Compares fold changes between two independent experimental runs or datasets. Calculates Pearson and Spearman correlation metrics and generates scatter plots to assess reproducibility and consistency of quantification across replicates."
---

This file is used to generate 'correlation plots': two-dimensional graphs that plot the foldchange for a given protein between two runs, across all the proteins in the sample.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --- SETUP: Load required libraries ---
library(broom)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(here)
library(pbapply)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(readxl)
library(reshape2)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)

# --- LOAD CONFIGURATION ---
source(here::here("src", "config.R"))
```

```{r data_loading_msstats}
# --- DATA LOADING: MSstats comparison results ---
# Use this chunk for the 'comparison_results' from MSstats
run1_file <- "339B-top4-features_comparison-results_imputed_v2.csv"
run2_file <- "339B_reruns-top4-features_comparison-results_imputed.csv"

run1 <- read_csv(
  run1_file,
  na = c("NA", "NaN"),
  col_types = cols(
    .default = col_guess(),
    log2FC = col_character()
  )
)

run2 <- read_csv(
  run2_file,
  na = c("NA", "NaN"),
  col_types = cols(
    .default = col_guess(),
    log2FC = col_character()
  )
)
```

```{r data_cleaning}
# --- DATA CLEANING ---
# Recode #NAME? and Inf values, drop unusable comparisons
clean_fc <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    select(Protein, Label, log2FC, issue, MissingPercentage, ImputationPercentage) %>%
    mutate(
      log2FC = case_when(
        log2FC == "#NAME?" ~ -10,      # user-specified truncation for #NAME?
        log2FC == "Inf"    ~  10,      # positive Inf -> +10
        log2FC == "-Inf"   ~ -10,      # handle negative Inf if present
        TRUE               ~ as.numeric(log2FC)
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(is.na(issue) | !issue %in% c("oneConditionMissing", "completeMissing")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(log2FC))
}

run1_clean <- clean_fc(run1) %>% rename(log2FC_run1 = log2FC)
run2_clean <- clean_fc(run2) %>% rename(log2FC_run2 = log2FC)
```

```{r data_processing}
# --- DATA PROCESSING ---
# Join runs on Protein + Label
fc_pairs <- inner_join(run1_clean, run2_clean,
                       by = c("Protein", "Label"))
```

```{r analysis}
# --- ANALYSIS: Correlation statistics ---
pearson_r  <- cor(fc_pairs$log2FC_run1, fc_pairs$log2FC_run2, method = "pearson")
spearman_r <- cor(fc_pairs$log2FC_run1, fc_pairs$log2FC_run2, method = "spearman")

pearson_r
spearman_r

fit <- lm(log2FC_run2 ~ log2FC_run1, data = fc_pairs)
coef(lm(log2FC_run2 ~ log2FC_run1, data = fc_pairs))

summary(fit)$r.squared
summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
```

```{r visualization}
# --- VISUALIZATION: Global scatterplot of log2FC between runs ---
p_all <- ggplot(fc_pairs, aes(x = log2FC_run1, y = log2FC_run2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = min(fc_pairs$log2FC_run1, na.rm = TRUE),
    y = max(fc_pairs$log2FC_run2, na.rm = TRUE),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(pearson_r, 2),
                   "\nSpearman rho = ", round(spearman_r, 2))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Protein-level log2 fold changes: Run 1 vs Run 2",
    x = "log2FC (Initial runs)",
    y = "log2FC (Reruns)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

p_all

# --- VISUALIZATION: One panel per contrast (Label) ---
p_by_label <- ggplot(fc_pairs, aes(x = log2FC_run1, y = log2FC_run2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ Label) +
  labs(
    title = "Run-to-run log2FC correlation by contrast",
    x = "log2FC (Initial runs)",
    y = "log2FC (Reruns)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

p_by_label
```

```{r export_msstats}
# --- EXPORT: Save MSstats correlation plots ---
ggsave("global_correlation_FPA.png", plot = p_all, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 300)
ggsave("correlation-by-group_FPA.png", plot = p_by_label, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r data_loading_fpa}
# --- DATA LOADING: FragPipe-Analyst DE results ---
# Use this chunk for the 'DE_results' from FragPipe-Analyst
run1_file <- "DE_results_FPA_initial.csv"
run2_file <- "DE_results_FPA_reruns.csv"

# Read everything as character so we don't lose '#NAME?' / 'Inf' info
run1 <- read_csv(run1_file, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
run2 <- read_csv(run2_file, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
```

```{r data_cleaning_fpa}
# --- DATA CLEANING: FragPipe-Analyst format ---
# Clean + reshape: wide -> long, recode special log2FC values
clean_fc <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    rename(
      Protein = `Protein ID`,
      Gene    = `Gene Name`
    ) %>%
    # One row per Protein x contrast
    pivot_longer(
      cols = ends_with("log2 fold change"),
      names_to = "Label",
      names_pattern = "(.*)_log2 fold change",
      values_to = "log2FC"
    ) %>%
    # Recode #NAME? and Inf, then convert to numeric
    mutate(
      log2FC = case_when(
        log2FC == "#NAME?" ~ "-10",
        log2FC == "Inf"    ~ "10",
        log2FC == "-Inf"   ~ "-10",
        TRUE               ~ log2FC
      ),
      log2FC = as.numeric(log2FC)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(log2FC))
}

run1_long <- clean_fc(run1) %>% rename(log2FC_run1 = log2FC)
run2_long <- clean_fc(run2) %>% rename(log2FC_run2 = log2FC)
```

```{r data_processing_fpa}
# --- DATA PROCESSING: Join runs on Protein + Label ---
fc_pairs <- inner_join(
  run1_long,
  run2_long,
  by = c("Protein", "Gene", "Label")
)
```

```{r analysis_fpa}
# --- ANALYSIS: Correlation statistics for FragPipe-Analyst data ---
pearson_r  <- cor(fc_pairs$log2FC_run1, fc_pairs$log2FC_run2, method = "pearson")
spearman_r <- cor(fc_pairs$log2FC_run1, fc_pairs$log2FC_run2, method = "spearman")

pearson_r
spearman_r

fit <- lm(log2FC_run2 ~ log2FC_run1, data = fc_pairs)

summary(fit)$r.squared
summary(fit)$adj.r.squared
```

```{r visualization_fpa}

    y = max(fc_pairs$log2FC_run2, na.rm = TRUE),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    label = paste0("Pearson r = ", round(pearson_r, 2),
                   "\nSpearman rho = ", round(spearman_r, 2))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Protein-level log2 fold changes: Run 1 vs Run 2",
    x = "log2FC (Initial runs)",
    y = "log2FC (Reruns)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

p_all

# --- VISUALIZATION: One panel per contrast ---
p_by_label <- ggplot(fc_pairs, aes(x = log2FC_run1, y = log2FC_run2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ Label) +
  labs(
    title = "Run-to-run log2FC correlation by contrast",
    x = "log2FC (Initial runs)",
    y = "log2FC (Reruns)"
  ) +

p_by_label
```
